Details
This listing includes three vintage pen sets from well-known manufacturers. The first is a Cross gold tone ballpoint pen in its original branded case, featuring the Cross logo and detailed clip with minimal wear. The second set is a Sheaffer pen set in a brown and cream case, containing a black fountain pen with a 14K gold nib and matching black ballpoint pen, both with gold accents and personalized engravings. The third item is a Sheaffer silver tone ballpoint pen in its original box, with the Sheaffer brand engraved on the barrel. All pens show gentle signs of use consistent with vintage writing instruments and are suitable for collectors.

These figures are shown both assembled in their green pipe bases and as individual pieces, highlighting their modular design and collectible appeal.
